role: Targeted qualitative checks by Codex against the fixed256 source. Not a comprehensive, blinded or independent human accuracy score. No raw caption is edited.

checks.finding: Caption places the circle left of the horizontal line; source has a full-width line below the circle. The regenerated short-text image places a short line beside the circle.
Caption calls the square centered; source square is on the right. Short caption correctly mentions right, showing more words are not always more faithful.
Both captions explicitly say centered horizontally, contradicting the right-hand source location.
Left position is preserved, but the horizontal line is omitted and the captions state there are no additional elements/details.
Both captions call the circle centered despite its left position. The bottom line is recognized.
Caption says coffee fills the cup to the brim; the input shows considerable empty white interior above the coffee.
Caption places handle on the right; source handle points lower-left.
Both captions say the bird faces right; the source bird faces left. The first-seed regeneration nevertheless faces left, illustrating that generator priors can override words.
Both captions say bird faces right instead of the source left. Preserve the raw failure independently of whether the receiver happens to correct it.
Framed photograph describes framing ambiguously; receiver draws a visible picture frame absent from the source. Rocket wording also simplifies the shuttle-stack structure.
